name: Hanamura Hina
source:
A one-eyed young girl who attends Hanazono Elementary School.

She is one of the main character's neighbors, and often played with him in kindergarten.

Although very shy and timid, she opens her heart to her onii-chan.

[translated from [url=https://teagashiya.wixsite.com/tea-gashiya2/hinalove]official website[/url]]
